INNOVATION & CODING CLUB
CAMPUS HACKATHON ANNOUNCEMENT

Calling all coders and problem solvers!
The Innovation Club is organizing an intra-college 24-hour hackathon.
Come build innovative software prototypes using open-source tools.

Eligibility: Open to all college students who love coding.
Team Size: 2 to 4 members per team.

Interested teams should start brainstorming ideas. Further details regarding registration link, closing deadline, required documents, and faculty coordinator contacts will be notified in due course.
